invghm.desc: A knight's great helm of riveted grey iron plates covering the whole head, seen from the front: a low flattened dome on top, near-vertical sides, the lower edge dipping to a blunt point at the chin, a raised ridge down the middle of the face, two narrow eye slits either side of the ridge, small breathing holes on the right cheek only, no brim, no visor, no crest, dents and rust patches.
invghm.note: the sample round's ghm words (round 2, approved)
